title: Affine subspace PCPP system
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number, let $V$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $a\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The Boolean PCPP system with proof length $2^n$ and three queries uses a verifier that is the uniform mixture of the affine-subspace proof tester and the affine-consistency tester.
caveat: The affine-consistency tester and the precise mixture operation are not defined in the supplied snippet.
